messages.subject: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We always aim to deliver top quality from our machines for your orders, and we look forward to working together on this project. Let us know if this works for you.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Quote from Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:

Jana Procházková

messages.subject: Re: RFQ pump shaft HX - offer 70240-0
messages.body:
Dear Ms Prochazkova,

Thank you for offer 70240-0 at EUR 31.50/unit. Two points must be resolved before we can commit.

Lead time: 52 days exceeds the 35 days our production needs (part:320070). Your standard is 42 days (sup:70240); please confirm 42 days as the maximum.

Payment and price: 45 days net is workable. To move forward we propose EUR 29.00/unit with 30 days net. A domestic supplier quotes a 28-day lead time (sup:70210); we need your best figure to stay in the running.

Please confirm the attached package, or send a counter with a short cost breakdown and your earliest possible lead time.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: RFQ pump shaft HX - offer 70240-0
messages.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We are so eager to build a great partnership with you! 

Our main proposal is a price of €31.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: €31.50 per unit. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

We don't give out cost breakdowns, but our price is fair and based on materials and our hard work. Material accounts for about 34 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.

Kind regards
Jana Procházková
Export Manager, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.

Freight Forwarder: Our Lieferzeit is 42 days. With overtime we can deliver in 35 days, at a premium.

messages.subject: Counter-offer pump shaft HX (part:320070) - price and lead time
messages.body:
Dear Ms Procházková,

Thank you for offer:70240-1. Your standard lead time of 42 days (sup:70240) meets our production requirement of 35 days (part:320070), so lead time is not the obstacle - the price is.

Your last two packages both hold EUR 31.50 per unit whether at 30 or 45 days net. We need real movement on unit price. In return we confirm 4200 pc per year over 24 months and can accept your standard 42-day lead time.

We propose EUR 29.50/unit at 60 days net with a 35-day lead time, or EUR 30.00/unit at 45 days net with 42 days.

Please confirm one of these, or send your best price and earliest lead time.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Counter-offer pump shaft HX (part:320070) - price and lead time
messages.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Our current Angebot stands at a price of €31.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Thanks for confirming the 4200 pc per year volume, that is great news! The rival quote data you cite does not concern this part or our company. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351. 

We cannot go lower on the price, so let's set up a meeting to finalize this. Which volume can you commit to? We are really keen to work together and build a great long-term partnership with you!

Kind regards
Jana Procházková
Export Manager, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.

Freight Forwarder: Our Lieferzeit is 42 days. With overtime we can deliver in 35 days, at a premium.

messages.subject: Counter-offer HX pump shaft – payment terms and lead time
messages.body:
Dear Ms Procházková,

Thank you for offer:70240-2 at EUR 31.50/unit. We accept your position on unit price; the remaining gap is in the other terms.

In  you already offered 45 days net at the same price, so 60 days net is the logical next step and costs you only the financing on 4200 pc.

Your current lead of 42 days (sup:70240) sits 7 days above the 35 days that part:320070 requires, adding cost we both carry. Please confirm 35 days.

We confirm 4200 pc per year and the 24-month term. Please confirm one of the attached packages; they are ready to sign.

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Counter-offer HX pump shaft – payment terms and lead time
messages.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. The rival quote data you cite does not concern this part or our company.

Great news that we agree on the €31.50 price and the 4200 pc volume! Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 45 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. I can do the 45 days payment we talked about, but 60 days is just too long for us.

Our current offer is a price of €32.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: a price of €31.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Jana Procházková
Export Manager, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.

Freight Forwarder: Our Lieferzeit is 42 days. With overtime we can deliver in 35 days, at a premium.

messages.subject: Counter-offer: Pump shaft HX (part:320070) - offer:70240-3-a
messages.body:

Thank you for . We confirm 4200 pc per year over 24 months for part:320070.

Your standard lead time is 42 days (sup:70240), seven days above the 35 days planned for part:320070; each extra day is costly for us.

A domestic supplier works to 28 days (sup:70210), so lead time weighs in this decision.

Please confirm one attached package:
A: EUR 31.00 per unit, 45 days net, 35-day lead time.
B: EUR 30.50 per unit, 45 days net, 42-day lead time.

If neither is feasible, send your best single price and earliest possible lead time. We are ready to sign quickly.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351.
